newsitem.title: CHINA: Novo Nordisk plans $60 mln China plant.
newsitem.headline: Novo Nordisk plans $60 mln China plant.

text.p: Danish biotechnology giant Novo Nordisk A/S is planning a $60 million pharmaceutical plant in China, a company executive said on Wednesday.
The company was committed to building the plant, possibly by the turn of the century, director of administration of Novo Nordisk China Humphrey Lau told Reuters. The plant site had yet to be decided.
"It depends on the speed and success of our development of the pharmaceutical market in China," Lau said by telephone.
Novo Nordisk has begun work on a new $10 million research facility for its operations in China, he said.
The new research facility in Beijing would also house the firm's China headquarters as part of the company's drive to make China a major production base, Lau said.
"Sales have been very convincing and that has been one of the factors persuading us to continue investing in China," Lau said. He declined to give sales figures in China.
Separately, the firm was working on a $200 million plant in China's northern city of Tianjin to produce industrial enzymes and insulin.
